description: Searches the setup guides for a question or a few words (not a single keyword). Returns document key, section heading and a short excerpt per match, best first — fetch the actual text with docs_get. Every answer names the JanuaPort release the guides belong to. Reads only; changes nothing.

frage.description: What you want to find — a question or a few words, not a single keyword. Word-level match: a hit needs at least one matching word; ranked by how many words matched.

name: docs_search

stand.description: JanuaPort release these guides belong to.

treffer.description: The matches, best first. Capped. Empty means nothing found — not an error.

abschnitt.description: Section heading — pass it to docs_get. Empty means the title matched.

ausschnitt.description: A short excerpt around the match.

id.description: Document key — pass it to docs_get.
